wstep: There is no recipe here for whole garlic heads fermented in brine with beetroot (pink garlic).

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to an Extension expert, fermentation is not an approved, safe method of preserving garlic, and there are currently no validated recipes for fermenting garlic.

akapity: The FDA list gives garlic a pH of about 5.80.
Low-acid foods have a pH above 4.6; they include all fresh vegetables except most tomatoes.
The whole product must contain a minimum, uniform level of acid so that botulism bacteria cannot grow.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for fermented garlic from a checked source.
